messages:
Sam K.: heads-up — multiple customers reporting a p95 jump on /v1/generate since ~03:00 UTC. dashboard shows p95 ~420ms (baseline ~120ms). anyone else seeing this?
Jia L.: i see it on the prometheus histogram panel too. interestingly the rollup quantile panel is showing a larger jump than the raw histogram — possible rollup windowing/weighting issue.
Alex R.: which dashboard? our rollup uses a 5m aggregation and the histogram panel is raw buckets from the ingest. i've seen mismatches when samples get delayed.
Sam K.: quick repro from a customer curl: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer x...' -d '{"prompt":"test"}' -w '\n%{time_total}\n'``` they got 0.45s and occasional 500s. attached logs show repeated retried requests to model-pool-7 around 03:02.
Maria O.: obs note: our panel config includes a 1m scrape + 5m rollup with sample-weighting. if ingest lagged at 02:59 that could inflate the rollup p95. also check proxy retry counts (those can push distribution mass into mid-latency).
Jia L.: i pulled raw histograms at 03:00-03:05 and there's a clear bimodal shift — some requests are fine, a subset at ~400ms. traces show extra proxy hop for that subset and many 429->retry sequences.
Alex R.: we deployed a queue backpressure change in canary yesterday (svc=generate, canary=10%). could be backpressure misrouting causing extra retries. rolling back canary now.
ops-bot: incident INC-2026-033 created and paged infra oncall (severity: P2).
Alex R.: rollback completed for canary (svc=generate). monitoring p95 now. :white_check_mark:
Sam K.: support update: customers who reported 500s re-tested, most responses are back to ~130ms. still watching one account with intermittent 500s (we asked for full trace).
Maria O.: observability follow-up: after rollback, rollup and histogram panels converged. lesson: rollup window + retry amplification can create spurious p95 spikes even when p99/tail unaffected. i'll add a dashboard annotation and a short blurb in the runbook about verifying proxy retry counts vs rollup windows.
Jia L.: mitigation notes: (1) monitor proxy retry rate as a first-class metric, (2) when investigating p95 spikes check raw histograms for bimodality, (3) consider temporarily routing traffic away from canary when p95 divergence observed.
Sam K.: thanks everyone — closing this thread once infra confirms last account repro.
Alex R.: infra confirmed last account fixed. closing. :thumbsup:
